{"id":1595312962,"question_id":3152,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1743664920,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"5 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1595312962/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Value of an Ordered Triplet II","memory":"90.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maximumTripletValue(vector<int>& nums) {\n    int max_i = 0;\n    int maxDiff = 0;\n    long long final =0;\n    \n    for(int k = 0 ; k<nums.size() ; k++)\n    {\n        final = max(final , (long long)maxDiff * nums[k]);\n        maxDiff = max(maxDiff , max_i - nums[k]);\n        max_i = max(max_i , nums[k]);\n    }\n\n    return final;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-value-of-an-ordered-triplet-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":529}
